observations.classification: conditional failure and existing connected owner question; no independently established defect
observations.analysis: The private gameplay OnceLock deserializes committed JSON and panics on decode failure. default_design clones the first matching open catalog_id and returns None for an absent key; this function does not perform recipe validation. The selected core item-catalog caller expects a melee default and expects successful derive_properties; that downstream function invokes identity admission and Construction::new invokes recipe.validate. If malformed committed data reaches the first expect, or a missing melee default or invalid design reaches the respective caller expect, it can panic. We did not inspect the dataset or prove any such actual input or reachability, and did not establish all callers use that downstream validation.
observations.nonfindings: The absent-key Option and recommended_holder None are supported by their interfaces; separate constant lists do not establish mismatch or invalidity.
observations.relationship: 774 rig ADDITIONAL-011 and 774 camera CAMERA-ADM03-057 already document the loader and missing semantic validation at this boundary; 059 queue index 1255 asks for canonical weapon/default-design source and consumers. Do not count this observation as a separate established defect or merge identities automatically.
observations.future_direction_if_needed: Trace actual committed data and consumers; if a source-backed contract is violated, place explicit validation or error handling at the appropriate authoritative boundary rather than presuming every Option is invalid.

observations.classification: reconciled bounded source relationship and policy questions; no independently established defect
observations.analysis: P16 decoder resolves item and its placement, rejects duplicate pointer pairs, sorts keys lexically and its optional lookup selects the first placement. The 95e version encodes the admitted relation as CatalogItem/CatalogPlacement, rejects duplicate selections, sorts the same keys and separates exact lookup from default_file_for. Those private wrappers prove membership and same-item placement only for the provided slice; they do not assert unique IDs, globally authoritative slice, content authenticity or eligibility. A selected current tactical path resolves raw item/placement text against the global catalog before lookup. Current from_json parses metadata fields but retains selection and file without inspecting the metadata values or imposing a filename/path policy; one inspected icon consumer silently skips a file without .glb suffix. If malformed embedded manifest decoding or membership fails and LazyLock is reached, this selected consumer panics. We did not inspect actual manifest content or native asset-loader behavior, and no defect or security issue follows solely from the stated policy gaps.
observations.nonfindings: An omitted placement and first lexical default are supported intended behavior in these bodies. The typed pair preserves its own item-placement relation; actual selection in a caller-provided slice does not by itself mean a global catalog identity.
observations.relationship: Original 774 rig ADDITIONAL-026 covers 106-line P16 decoder; its CONTRACT-055 and CONTRACT-056 already cover the later PR typed design and explicitly qualify unchecked metadata. The selected current boundary narrows but does not resolve 059 queue index 2482, L12-CLOSURE-RUNTIME-EQUIPMENT-PRESENTATION-IDENTITY; raw upstream runtime, sockets, cache and native consumers remain separately unresolved. Prior 95e role 922/assessment remains separately attributed. No automatic alias or closure.
observations.future_direction_if_needed: Establish the intended producer-to-native filename and metadata contract and trace remaining identities; only if the actual input is required to guarantee more, assign validation and propagation to its true owner.

thirteen_bounded_lenses.producer_propagation: Current selected tactical boundary maps raw identifiers to the global catalogue; upstream/native/socket/cached propagation remains open. Default weapon caller has a downstream derive gate, not a proof about all callers.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.existing_type_owners: CatalogItem/CatalogPlacement own slice-relative relations in current assets; raw catalog IDs and manifest file names remain boundary data. Global ownership beyond these windows remains open.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.admission_contracts: Serde parsing, membership/duplicate rejection, embedded caller expects and explicit lack of content/path admission are source-backed and conditional on input; full data admission not assessed.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.invariant_operations: Pointer equality and the retained placement ordinal derive from the same immutable snapshot in inspected constructors; this bounded path exposes no established mutation bypass.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.aggregate_states: Current wrappers connect each placement to its actual item and reject duplicate selected pairs. Source does not establish whole-catalog uniqueness or validate relation between unretained metadata fields.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.type_ownership: Selection belongs to its supplied catalogue slice; whether broader runtime presentation should retain the same owner remains a connected question.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.redundant_authority: Weapon catalog ID lists and raw manifest keys are potential multiple authorities requiring data/consumer trace, not proof of conflicting truth.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.behavior_preservation: P16 optional placement lookup and 95e explicit default both select first lexical available placement within these functions; no runtime or broader behavioral validation performed.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.enum_shapes: Option placement legitimately distinguishes explicit and default lookup here; no demonstrated enum or optionality defect within actual reads.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.derivability: Serde derives and pointer equality serve different visible roles; no unsupported derive replacement asserted from bounded evidence.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.type_granularity: Borrowed CatalogItem/CatalogPlacement distinguish membership and association from unvalidated text; they intentionally do not guarantee global uniqueness or eligibility.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.magic_strings: Catalog, placement, file, schema release and icon suffix text carry distinct meanings; data content, filename policy and all consumers remain open.
thirteen_bounded_lenses.magic_numbers: Schema/lod/count/coverage values decode but are not semantically checked here; whether further constraints are required is an unproved boundary-policy question.
